paragraph: South Hackensack is a small market, and the last six months produced exactly one recorded single-family sale. That home closed at $750,000 against a $699,000 list price in nine days, which works out to a sale-to-list ratio slightly under 1.08. One sale tells you a well-priced house here can move fast and draw a competitive bid. It does not tell you what the town's median is, and it cannot support any trend claim, seasonal or otherwise. There was no condo, townhouse, co-op, or multi-family activity to read at all. If you're buying or selling here, you'll want to widen the comparison set to neighboring Bergen County towns, because the local sample is too thin to price off of on its own.
